title: Rahm returns from LIV absence to claim Abu Dhabi title
gist: Jon Rahm won the Abu Dhabi Championship by two strokes over Tyrrell Hatton in his first DP World Tour event since leaving the LIV Golf tour, which the text describes as bankrupt; the investor-relevant signal is LIV's collapse and top players' return to the established tour.

themes.theme: LIV Golf collapse and talent flow back
